entries.trigger: For normative requirements,
entries.behaviour: use MUST/MUST NOT for obligations/prohibitions, SHOULD for a default whose exceptions need justification and MAY for permission; uppercase alone carries these meanings.

entries.trigger: When requirements affect implementation or acceptance,
entries.behaviour: retain source, trigger, observable outcome and acceptance evidence; use conditional wording to remove ambiguity.

entries.trigger: For material quality or assurance claims,
entries.behaviour: state the quality scenario, claim, supporting argument and current evidence; keep gaps blocking when the contract requires proof.

entries.trigger: When choosing tests,
